verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents a REST API with a published OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec and a ReadMe reference that includes a balances endpoint. Its MCP integration exposes trial balance, journal entries, transactions and ledger account tools, so ledger data is reachable programmatically in structured form. However, no documented REST endpoint is evidenced for pulling the full general ledger, and API access is request-gated. The full-GL CSV/Excel export is an in-app export, not an API feature. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented REST endpoint for the full general ledger and trial balance, documented open-format (e.g. CSV) output via the API, self-serve API access, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull the full general ledger and trial balance through a documented API in open formats

citations.quote: Puzzle publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document (info title "Puzzle Api", server https://app.puzzle.io/rest/v0) on its app domain
